schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hint: The worker keeps a rolling window of months fresh, one month per check. A pause or a restart never causes a burst: a month that fell behind is imported once, not once for every interval that passed. Turning this off stops Allet looking for work on its own; a month you queue below still runs.
schedule.enabled: Keep the next months up to date automatically
schedule.failed: The schedule could not be saved.

tasks.title: Queued months
tasks.hint: Months in the rolling window appear here on their own. Add a month to import one outside the window: it runs at the next check even when automatic refresh is off, then stops being tracked.
tasks.failed: The queue could not be changed.
